messages:
elaine: quick heads-up — started seeing a p99 latency spike (~17:14 UTC) on prod-gateway, error rate up ~1.8%. Traces point to a recent connpool change. I opened a rollback PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4216 — can someone take a quick look and approve if CI is green? tagging @miguel @raj. will stand by to merge and watch canary.

miguel: on it, pulling logs now. if tests pass i'll give an approve. how long do you want the canary window?

elaine: thanks. start with 20% for 5m then 100% if stable. will monitor traces and token latency dashboard.

raj: looking at traces — a few hosts show connection saturations and long tail retries. rollback makes sense as immediate mitigation. i'll review the PR for safety.

carmen: minor nit: PR doesn't update the migrate script comment, but not a blocker for rollback. prefer to merge ASAP then follow up.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #4216. integration-tests: green. staging deploy: succeeded.

miguel: left one tiny comment in PR (inline). not blocking. approving now. :thumbsup:

raj: approved. also adding a follow-up ticket to tune connpool backoff and add an e2e for high-concurrency.

oncall-shaun: watching grafana — p95 still elevated but p99 started dropping after the revert candidate tested in staging. ready to hit merge once you confirm.

elaine: merging in ~2m. will kick canary at 20% and call it up to 100% after 5m if no regressions. oncall watch: @oncall-shaun pls escalate if error rate creeps back.

deploy-bot: PR #4216 merged by miguel at 17:38 UTC. Canary rollout: 20% started. Links: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/prod-gateway, traces: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/trace/xyz.

oncall-shaun: canary 20% looks clean so far. p99 down to baseline. will keep monitoring for the next 10m.

elaine: excellent — leaving follow-up ticket for connpool/backoff. thanks all for quick review + merge. :heart:
